title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteCollectionVehicle
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteCollectionVehicle. Purpose-built vehicle for the collection and transport of waste, whereby the refuse is transferred by differential air pressure, a lifting device, mechanical means or hand (source: ISO 24161:2022, clause 3.2.2.6). In the case of human-powered waste collection vehicles, they are not necessarily purpose-built for the collection and transport of waste. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.2.1.6).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteCollectionVehicle'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the waste collection vehicle, expressed as a GeoJSON Point (current position).

hasDepot.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/hasDepot'. A waste collection vehicle is assigned one depot. Links to a Depot entity.

maximumSpeed.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/MaximumSpeed'. Highest speed at which a waste collection vehicle can go. Unit: km/h.

vehicleKind.description: Property. Open/enumerated vocabulary, flattened from saref:hasFeatureKind whose range is s4envi:WasteCollectionVehicleKind -- not modelled as its own entity. Known individuals (non-exhaustive): 'CargoBicycle' (human-powered vehicle in the form of a bicycle featuring a storage area for transporting loads), 'Lorry' (electric, gas-powered or internal-combustion engine vehicle featuring a rear storage area for transporting loads).
